structured.answer: The site can't yet calculate gold and commodities (ETC, gold ETFs), most bonds and debt (corporate bonds, Israel Bonds, commercial paper, commitment notes, debt settlements), foreign-currency accounts and deposits including the FX conversion fee itself, structured products, insurance-based savings (savings policies, managers' insurance, Fund Y), pension commutation and other retirement tax items, REITs, digital portfolios and portfolio management. Every one is marked "לא מחושב" because their rules are "עוד בבדיקה", and it says outright it will never cover single stocks, trading, derivatives, loans or past-performance rankings.
